events.title: The Broken Circuit Debt
events.prose: Leo handed Rosa a cracked data-shard that looked far too expensive for her budget. He smiled when she pointed out the fractures, but he still hasn't delivered the decryption key she paid for.

events.title: A Bitter Morning Toast
events.prose: Mikael sat across from Rosa in a corner booth, his eyes darting toward the door. He left half a plate of synthetic eggs and a heavy, unspoken apology sitting between them.

events.title: The Hum of Static
events.prose: Kaelen spent the night whispering apologies to a malfunctioning signal relay. He handed Rosa a small, salvaged component, though his hands were still shaking from the voltage.

events.title: Old Tales in Rain
events.prose: Elias pointed toward the skyline, describing how the clouds used to look before the neon glare. He stopped mid-sentence when a patrol drone hummed overhead, leaving his memory unfinished.

memories.text: Elias watched the sun set over the skyline before the neon lights drowned out the horizon.
He handed Rosa a faded photograph of a garden that no longer existed.
He owed the city a debt of silence for the things he saw in the old streets.
Mikael left a plate of synthetic eggs untouched while he watched the door at the Ozone Breakfast Club.
He offered Rosa a heavy, unspoken apology that never quite reached his lips.
He flashed a grin that promised trouble even when his heart felt the weight of his debts.
Kaelen whispered apologies to the malfunctioning signal relay for hours.
He handed a small, salvaged component to Rosa.
His hands shook from the lingering voltage after the repair.
Leo handed Rosa a cracked data-shard that cost more than she could afford.
He smiled when Rosa pointed out the fractures in the glass.
He kept the decryption key she paid him for.
